 Description
Présentation de SIGN/e, plugiciel d'édition visuelle pour lire et écrire des partitions graphiques directement dans Ableton Live. Importez, modifiez et animez des images PNG. SIGN/e permet de dépasser les limites des logiciels de notation conventionnelle pour créer des partitions qui comblent le fossé entre votre session Ableton Live et votre performance en direct.
👉 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vKb5_8wRGYs <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vKb5_8wRGYs>
Nicolas Bernier 
est professeur en composition et création sonore à la Faculté de musique de l’Université de Montréal. Au centre de sa recherche-création se trouvent principalement des questionnements sur la performativité du son électronique. Depuis 2016, il contribue activement au développement de la musique électronique en ensemble avec 
Ensemble d’oscillateurs <https://lfo-lab.ca/ensemble-oscillateurs>
, à la fois un projet de recherche-création et un projet pédagogique. L’ensemble propose des pistes d’écriture de partition et de technique d’interprétation en musique électronique tout en interprétant du répertoire historique de la early electronics comme les oeuvres des compositrices pionnières Pauline Oliveros et Else Marie Pade. L'ensemble publie une série de trois disques sur l’étiquette états-unienne LINE et se produit dans d’importants festivals, dont Sight & Sound, Akousma et Mutek. Le projet mène au développement de projets de recherche-création portant notamment sur 
l’esthétique de l’onde sinusoïdale <https://lfo-lab.ca/onde-sinusoidale>
(2021-2024) et sur la 
notation performative <https://lfo-lab.ca/notation-performative>
 (2024-27), projet dans lequel s’inscrit le développement du plugiciel SIGN/e.

Minimum ability required: there will be lots of stairs!

Town Hall

Why they served, 
by Professor David O'Keefe
Free to attend, 
registration on Amilia <https://app.amilia.com/store/en/ville-de-montreal-ouest/shop/programs/123994?subCategoryIds=7374766>

PAC Meeting
November 4 2026 
Town Hall
The 
Planning Advisory Committee (PAC) <https://montreal-ouest.ca/en/our-town/town-council/committees/#pac>
 is entrusted with the review of all building projects subject to the Town’s Site Planning and Architectural Integration Program (SPAIP). The deadline for submitting a complete file application is 2 weeks prior to the PAC meeting.
 2 / 2 
A Walk to Remember
November 7 2026 at 11:00 am
Sports and Recreation Centre
Explore Montreal West with Dr. Robert Drummond and pay tribute to our veterans on this guided tour.
Meet at the Sports and Recreation Centre (220 Bedbrook) on Saturday, November 7, at 11 a.m.
 1 / 1 
Remembrance Ceremony
November 8 2026 at 12:30 pm
Cenotaph
The Remembrance Ceremony will take place on Sunday, November 8, at 12:30 pm at the Montreal West Cenotaph, located next to the Town Hall at 50 Westminster Av. South.
Prior to the ceremony, a small procession will begin at 12:15 pm from the corner of Curzon and Westminster, making its way to the Cenotaph, led by a piper.
 1 / 1 
CPKC Holiday Train
November 19 2026 at 6:00 pm
Montreal West Train Station, Broughton Road
The CPKC Holiday Train is coming to town
 on Thursday, November 19 at 7:00 p.m. with live musical performances by 
Magic! <https://www.cpkcr.com/en/community/HolidayTrain/holiday-train-artists#magic!>
 and 
MARIS <https://www.cpkcr.com/en/community/HolidayTrain/holiday-train-artists#maris>
.
Food and entertainment begin at 6:15 p.m. along Broughton.
Children’s entertainer 
Shawny <https://www.shawnykidsmusic.com/>
.
Roaming entertainers 
Le souffleur de glace <https://richardlacroix.com/noel-hiver-arl/souffleur.html>
 and 
Devana <https://animationrl.sharepoint.com/:b:/g/IQAKyrgbKBiMSbGKTL8_lDZQAS3xynIcaJmiWW8JdA5xTr8?e=iXIOHz>
Free hot dogs and hot chocolate. Donations to Moisson Montréal are welcome!
A Beaver Tails food truck will be on Broughton between Westminster and Ballantyne South.
 1 / 1 
Parents Night Off
November 20 2026 from 5:00 pm to 9:00 pm
Sports and Recreation Centre
Give yourself a break and sign up your child for an exciting evening at the community centre! Kids aged 4-10 will enjoy games, crafts, and movies, making it a fun-filled night they won’t forget!
Pizza and juice will be served, but parents can pack a peanut-free meal for their children if preferred.
When: 5 PM - 9 PM 
Where: Sports and Recreation Centre
Cost: $25 for residents 
$35 for non-residents
Spaces are limited—register today on 
Amilia <https://app.amilia.com/store/en/ville-de-montreal-ouest/shop/programs/137760>
 and treat yourself to a well-deserved night off!
 1 / 1 
Music with Shawny
November 21 2026 at 9:00 am
Davies Chalet 
Come sing, dance, and have fun with local educator Shawny at monthly music sessions
designed for young children! Through lively, interactive songs, kids will be encouraged to
sing along, dance, and move to the beat in a fun and welcoming environment. Along the way,
they’ll explore important themes such as self-confidence, acceptance, and kindness toward
others. Parents are required to attend and participate alongside their child.
9:00 am to 9:30 am (0 to 2 years old)
9:45 am to 10:15 am (3 to 5 years old)
Register on Amilia <https://app.amilia.com/store/en/ville-de-montreal-ouest/shop/programs/125549>

Holocaust Remembrance
November 25 2026 at 1:00 pm
Sports and Recreation Centre
Joey Schreter shares the remarkable stories of his parents, Holocaust Survivors, Irving Schreter and Paula “Bobbie” Schreter whose very different journeys of survival ultimately became one family story.
Free to attend, registration is encouraged. 
Register on Amilia <https://app.amilia.com/store/en/ville-de-montreal-ouest/shop/activities/7374767>
 or at the Sports and Recreation Centre (514-484-6186)
